titulo: Clear Answers About Taxes and SUNAT Compliance
subtitulo: Everything you need to know about 4th and 5th categories, withholding suspensions, tax deductions, and audit defense.
side_desc: Contact me directly via WhatsApp to review your tax status at my Surquillo office or via online consultation nationwide across Peru.
ws_msg: Hello Lourdes, I have a tax inquiry regarding my situation with SUNAT.

faqs.pregunta: At what amount is the 8% 4th-category tax withheld?
faqs.respuesta: If you issue an Electronic Fee Receipt (RHE) to a company exceeding S/ 1,500, the company is required to withhold 8% income tax, unless you have obtained an official Withholding Suspension Certificate (Form 1609).

faqs.pregunta: How and when should I file for Withholding Suspension (Form 1609)?
faqs.respuesta: This procedure is completed online through SUNAT Operaciones en Línea when you project that your annual 4th and 5th category earnings will not exceed SUNAT's legal threshold (approx. S/ 45,063). I file your certificate promptly so you receive your full fee payments without unnecessary deductions.

faqs.pregunta: How does the additional 3 UIT deduction work to claim tax refunds?
faqs.respuesta: Every worker in 4th or 5th categories receives an automatic 7 UIT deduction, plus up to 3 additional UITs supported by electronic invoices bearing their DNI: restaurants/bars (15%), hotels (15%), independent professional services (30%), and domestic worker healthcare contributions (100%). This generates credit balances eligible for direct bank account refunds.

faqs.pregunta: What should I do if I receive an audit notice in my SUNAT SOL mailbox?
faqs.respuesta: Do not ignore the deadline. Inductive letters or citations frequently stem from bank transfer cross-checks (ITF) or payroll discrepancies. As a former SUNAT officer, I examine your file with you, determine the issue, and prepare an evidentiary response before it turns into a fine or tax audit.

faqs.pregunta: What makes my professional approach different from a general accountant?
faqs.respuesta: I specialize strictly in Personal Income Taxes (4th and 5th categories) and SUNAT tax audits. Having served directly inside the tax agency as a tax advisor, I understand the exact detection routines, cross-referencing criteria, and legal interpretations used by tax auditors.

faqs.pregunta: Where do I see clients and what payment methods do I accept?
faqs.respuesta: I offer in-person consultations by appointment at Jr. Dante 260, Surquillo, Lima, as well as live online video consultations nationwide via Meet / Zoom. I accept bank transfers (BCP, BBVA, Interbank) and digital wallets Yape and Plin.
